web_events.query: China PMI economic data this week
web_events.answer: China's official Purchasing Managers' Index (PMI) for August was released today, showing a slight improvement to 49.8 from July's 49.2, indicating that while factory activity remains in contraction, there is a marginal positive trend. The Caixin/RatingDog PMI also edged up to 51.0 in August from 50.9 in July, reflecting a slight recovery in the private sector manufacturing. Despite these figures, both indices remain below the 50-point mark that separates contraction from expansion.
